title: 16. Review the full path through a paged client

examples.explanation: Item 1 is on both pages. Keep it once.
Page `a` points back to itself: stop with `cycle`.
Page `b` returns 503: stop with `upstream` and keep item 1.

hints: Use separate sets for visited cursors and accepted item ids.
Check cycle before limit, then record an attempted fetch before looking up its fixture.
